title: "Canadian Forest Growth & Yield Model Registry"

# Explore Canadian forest growth and yield models

This private-first catalogue has one entry per model, with a short summary,
the jurisdictions where it is used, and links to the model's website and
repository. Browse the [model catalogue](models.qmd) to filter by model type,
management context, species keyword, and province or territory, or use the
[coverage map](map.qmd) to see which models are recorded for each jurisdiction.

**This registry is a starting point, not the authoritative source.** Models
evolve (new species, new coverage areas, new versions) and this registry is
updated only periodically. Use the links on each entry to the model's website
and repository for current details. A province-level filter can include a model
used in only part of that province, or in an adjoining US state; read each
coverage entry's region before using a model for a location. Missing
information is shown as "Not recorded", not inferred from other fields or links.

The map is jurisdiction-level only, and a downloadable query database is not
yet available. A filled province or territory is not a model footprint, a
calibration or validation statement, or a recommendation.
